title: Shank Definition v2
description: Mirrors backend/jewelmind/ring/models.py::ShankDefinition. CURRENT: uniform, split and bypass shanks, plus real width/thickness taper. Maps 1:1 from JewelryDefinition.band — and that claim is load-bearing, which is why the five architecture fields are here: Sprint 28 added them to BandSpec and left this mirror behind until it was fixed. 'Band' remains the user-facing/JDL name; 'Shank' is the internal architectural term. The real geometry contract for widthTaper/thicknessTaper lives at specs/shank/v1/taper-definition.schema.json — this file only documents its presence on the Ring v2 domain model, never redefines it. See docs/bible/19-shank/556-current-band-migration.md and docs/bible/30-ring-families/execution-boundary.md.

architecture.description: Which shank construction runs. Normally DERIVED from the ring-family variant rather than set directly.

splitSeparationMm.description: The axial gap between a split shank's two rails. The rails SHARE the band's width, so a wider separation NARROWS them rather than widening the ring; JM-RINGFAM-004 refuses one that leaves no rail.

splitJoinSpanDeg.description: How much of the ring's bottom the two rails are joined over.

bypassSeparationMm.description: The axial distance a bypass rail travels across its sweep, and therefore the clearance between its two passes at the crossing.

bypassOverlapDeg.description: How far past a full turn the bypass rail travels — what makes its two ends pass each other rather than meet.
